title: acacia angustissima subsp. suffrutescens
intro: Acacia angustissima subsp. suffrutescens, commonly known as Mexican Buckthorn, is a shrub-like plant belonging to the Acacia genus, native to Mexico and parts of Central America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiparasitic properties. The therapeutic actions of Mexican Buckthorn include modulating the immune system, reducing pain and inflammation, and exhibiting antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Acacia angustissima subsp. suffrutescens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
